title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. We have own house. 3rd floor of the house is not build yet. Our neighbor offered us to construct the 3rd floor, He give total cost as a condition that he stay one apartment as rent free for next three years. This floor will became 4 apartment. Another 3 apartment we give rent others tenant. After 3 years we paid her full money which he give for build house and he leave home. My question, is it permissible in islam? Mention that: 1. He get back her full money after 3 years which he give for constructing house as he benefited he will stay rent free. 2. We collect her money from rent price of the rest 3 apartment. 3. If we deny he may keep money in bank and get interest and the interest become close to rent price per month. Please answer as soon as possible. 1577 views Q. Dear Sir, I have built a commercial building by the grace of Allah. The building is now nearing completion. Please advise me if I could rent out the builing to a 1. Bank 2. Insurance Company. 3. Hotel who serves drinks with food. I have also some loans to be paid to the bank in these circumstances please advise accordingly in the matter with Islamic law points. 1717 views Q. 1.if 10 candidat collect money for a certain period of time like 10 months and the total amount is 1 lakh, one person will have to pay 10000 every month, and we make draw, the person who got his name will get the total amount of 1 lakh. we call it committee,is it jayez. 7306 views Q. Currently there is a difference of opinion regarding what is known as ?Islamic Banking.? There are some ulama that are of the opinion that this type of banking and the services that they provide are halaal and a practicing Muslim should have not fear and fully take advantage of the variety of services being offered by these same banks. On the other hand there are a group of scholars that aver that this type of banking is no different than regular commercial non Islamic banks. The only differences being in the terminology, but the actual transactions fall into the category of riba. Our question to the ulama ikram is: in the opinion of your darul iftaa, which group is correct, as both can not be correct in this case. Please explain your fatwa completely which will eliminate the doubts in the minds of the common people. 2588 views Q. In Canada, when we buy a house, bank pays for us and then we pay monthly mortgage to the bank. Out of this mortgage amount, most part(about 700 out of 1000) is going to bank as interest and only a small amount is going to our payment and that way we are struggling whole life to get rid of this big amount. Alhamdolillah Im still away from this Riba problem but a lot of Muslims are involved in mortgages and im also pressed by friends to get a house(i live on rental), so my questions today are 1...Is this kind of mortgage is allowed assuming that there is no option other than living on rent! 2...People are doing business also like they buy a house and sell after some time with profit while paying riba to the bank as mortgage, is this property business is halal while involving in riba mortgage! 3...Most important, is paying sood is equally condemned and haram sin as getting(eating) sood! 4...After getting pressed by my friends to get mortgage, when I say its haram, they say Islam is not that narrow as you have made and Allah(SWT)forgives this kind of sins because they are necessary for life, what is your opinion! 5499 views Q. Is it allowed to use credit cards if i am not paying any intrest. also i have credit card machine which i Ineeded to keep for my customers who are coming from abroad. please advice. 2243 views Q. I am a surgeon working in Mohali,Punjab 1.Recently I got health Insurance of my family.Is it Allowed in Islam? 2.I am planning to buy car on loan.Is allowed in Islam? 1856 views Q. My uncle (own elder sister's husband) has a land. But he is not cultivating this for last one year because he doesn't have money. He has a plan to cultivate sugarcane. We agreed that I'll give all money for cultivating the land, and after harvesting the sugarcane whatever the amount comes, we will divide into five parts and three part I'll take and two part he'll take. He won't give the money what I invested in that land. Please tell me that doing so is halal? 2. Can we take loan to do business? 1485 views Q. Is commercial broking halal or haram? For example: A person helps another person buy a shop worth 1 lakh in return expects 2000 rupees or 2% of the total 1263 views Q. Questions on NGO 4063 views Q. I want to know about subsidizing loan sanction by the government under some scheme to minorities 2201 views Q. Assalam-U-Alaikum. I want to know whether there is a permission in Islam to purchase a car on Installments. As per my knowledge, under installment scheme, you are supposed to pay the actual cost fixed intrest per month. But the cost is predecided by the bank for eg. if the vehicle cost is 4 lakhs, and if you are paying the installments in 3 years, bank will calculate the intrest and give you the final figure of 5.5 lakhs. So the cost of the car is 5.5 lakhs for you, which you are supposed to pay in 3 years. But if you change your plan of making payment in 4 years, then the total value of car will increase. So Please let me know whether we can purchase a car on installment. I can not buy a car by paying entire amount in cash, and car is very important for me to buy. Will be thankful to you for your advise. 2156 views Q. My friend asked one question (i.e) he want to give his shop agreement basis (i.e) he will be get 2 Lakhs from his friend for 2 years(till 2 years his frined will be utilized that shop) After 2 Years my frind will be retrun back 2 Lakhs to his friend. Question is "My frined want to know is it permissible in Islam. Your quick response will be greatly appreciated. 1598 views Q. Exchange of Mobile 2036 views Q. Other Transaction 2025 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Other Transactions Question ID: 31573 Country: India Title: interest of SBI account Question: I am working as a lecturer in government polytechnic krishnarajpet, mandya distric karnataka.our salary is paid through SB account.As we have to pay annual income tax to the goverment. can we used the interest amount of the bankto pay the income tax at financial year end. Answer ID: 31573 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 758/266/TL=1432) The interest amount can be paid in income tax. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
